title: The Personal Edit
direction: An asymmetrical editorial composition in warm ivory, muted evergreen and soft sage. Large Newsreader typography, a softly arched natural portrait, visible treatment-area rows, an open first-visit sequence, and a dedicated rate sheet lead to the shared consultation form.
owner_feedback: Design 04 is the strongest reference for restrained colors, calmness and readable type. Distinct composition and content hierarchy; no generated portrait/treatment imagery or botanical hero.

research.use: Reviewed current electrology conversion structure: prominent scope, practitioner credentials and accessible prices. No claims, certifications, services or outcomes copied.
Reviewed practitioner-led positioning and the relationship between personal care and scientific training. No credentials or testimonials transferred.
Reviewed benefit-led service hierarchy, readable session options and direct conversion paths. No promotions, memberships or unrelated services transferred.
Hair colors, follicle treatment, modalities and individualized repeat-session guidance.
Treatment process, sensation, factors affecting timing and temporary skin responses.
All skin tones and hormonal-hair context; medical diagnosis remains outside electrology scope.
Consultation discussion, possible sample treatment, credentials and privacy as trust signals.

image.license: Unsplash License; image page explicitly marks free use. Commercial use permitted; attribution not required.
image.treatment: Downloaded photograph at display-appropriate resolution. No AI generation, retouching or skin alteration. CSS crop only.
image.placement: General hero image; no identification as Nav, a client, a treatment outcome or the studio. Practitioner section is typographic and separate.

business_facts: Owner-supplied baseline: Nav is a California-licensed electrologist with Microbiology education from UC Davis and completed professional electrology training at California Electrology Academy in Corona. Face and selected non-intimate body scope retained.
prices: Read from config/treatment-pricing.json through unchanged TreatmentRates: USD 15m65, 30m95, 45m135, 60m175, 90m265, 120m350. No consultation fee inferred.
consultation: Unchanged ConsultationForm includes hydration-safe ConsultationController, verified endpoint and Turnstile config, required names/full US phone, optional email/context, permission/privacy, and accessible success dialog.
preservation: All prior numbered routes and their approved November 15 source/static/assets are preserved. Current homepage source and HTML explicitly added to the frozen manifest without changing their bytes.
